facts.statement: The Memorial Day and Spring Chicken pack promotion ran from 7:00 AM PDT Friday May 27 to 11:59 PM PDT Monday May 30, 2011.
facts.quote: The promotion begins at 7:00 AM PDT on Friday, May 27 and ends at 11:59 PM PDT on Monday, May 30.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - Quais são as Novidades? (Memorial Mania May 27th through May 30th)
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news page (Portuguese site wrapper, English body text) promoting the Memorial Mania event of May 27-30, 2011. It lists two Station Cash item packs with prices and states the Station Cash card bonus and the New Member Bonus Bonanza that was running at the time.
